content: Yaaqoobe Nayta
Yaaqoobey 12 attuma nayta yelides; heytikka Oroobeele, Simoona, Lewe, Yuhuda, Yisakoore, Zaabiloone,
Daane, Yooseefe, Biniyaame, Niftaaleme, Gaadenne Aaseere.
Yuhuda Nayta
Yuhuday Kanaane dere as Shu7a biype Eera, Oonaanenne Seela geetettiza heedzdzu attuma nayta yelides; izas bayra naazi Eeray GODAA sinththan iita as gidida gishshas GODAY iza boshan wodhides.
Yuhudaykka ba naaza machcho Ti7imaarippe Paareesenne Zaraahe geetettiza nam7u attuma nayta yelides; Yuhuday ichchash attuma nayta yelides.
Paarise Attuma Nayta
Paareeseykka Hexiroomenne Hamule geetettiza nam7u attuma nayta yelides.
Zaraahe Nayta
Zaraahey ichchashu attuma nayta yelides; heytikka Zimire, Etaane Hemaane, Kalkolenne Daara.
Zaraahe zereththafe gidida Karme naa Akaaney Xoossas dummatida di7o miishshafe kaysotidi qottida gishshas Isra7eele deraa bolla meto ehides.
Etaaneykka Azaariya geetettiza issi attuma naa yelides.
Hexiroomey heedzdzu attuma nayta yelides; heytikka Yerahim7eele, Aaraamenne Kaalube.
Kawo Dawite Yeleta Zarkke
Aaraamey Aminadaabe yelides; Aminadaabey Yuhuda naytas halaqa gidida Ne7asoone yelides.
Ne7asooney Salamo yelides; Salamoykka Boo7eeze yelides.
Boo7eezey Iyoobeede yelides; Iyoobeedeykka Isseye yelides.
Isseye Attuma Nayta
Isseye bayra naazi Elyaabe; Elyaabe kaaloti Abinadaabe, Shim7a,
Natina7eele, Eraade,
Oxeemenne Dawite.
Istta michcheti Xuriyanne Abigaalo geetetteettes; Xuriyay Abisaye, Iyo7aabenne Asaheele geetettiza heedzdzu attuma nayta yeladus.
Abigaala Isma7eele zereththafe gidida Yootores Amasa geetettiza attuma naa yeladus.
Hexiroome Naa Kaalebe Zereththata
Hexiroome naa Kaalebey Azubbo geetettizaaro machcho ekkidi Yir7aato geetettiza macca naa yelides; Yir7aatakka Yeshere, Shoobaabenne Ardoone geetettiza heedzdzu attuma nayta yeladus.
Azubba hayqqidaappe guye Kaalebey Efraato machcho ekkidi Huure geetettiza attuma naa yelides.
Huureykka Uure geetettiza attuma naa yelides; Uurey Basli7eele yelides.
Hexiroomey izas 60 layth kumishin Gala7aade aawa Maakire nayo machcho ekkidi Sagube yelides.
Sagubeykka Ya7ire yelides; Ya7irey Gala7aade deren diza 23 katamata ayssees.
Gido attiin Geeshureynne Aaraamey Qenaateninne izi heeran diza 60 qeeri katamatanne Ya7ire katamata oli oykkida; heyti ubbayka Gala7aade aawa Maakire zereththata.
Hexiroomey Kaalebe Efraata geetettizason hayqqidaappe guye iza machcha Abiyay Tequhe aawa Ashihuure izas yeladus.
Hexiroome Naa Yirahim7eele Zereththata
Hexiroomes bayra naazi Yerahim7eeley 5 attuma nayta yelides; heytappe bayrazi Eraama, iza kaaloti Buna, Oore, Oxeemenne Akaya geetetteettes.
Yerahim7eeles Axaaro geetettiza hara machcha dawus; iza Oonname aayo.
Yerahim7eeles bayra naa Eraamay Maaxe, Yaaminenne Eqere geetettiza attuma nayta yelides.
Oonnamey Shamayenne Yaadda geetettiza attuma nayta yelides; Shamayey Nadaabenne Abishuure geetettiza attuma nayta yelides.
Abishuureykka Abihaylo geetettizaaro machcho ekkidi Ahibaanenne Moolide yelides.
Nadaabey Seledenne Afayme yelides; Seledey gidikko naa yelontta hayqqides.
Afaymey Yushi7e yelides; Yushi7ey Sheshaane yelides; Sheshaaney Ahilaye yelides.
Shamaye isha Yaadday Yootorenne Yoonataane yelides; Yootorey gidikko naa yelontta hayqqides.
Yoonataaney Paletenne Zaaza geetettiza 2 attuma nayta yelides; heyti wurikka Yerahim7eele zereththata.
Sheshaanes macca naytappe attiin hara attuma nay deenna; izas ooththiza Gibxe dere as Yaraha geetettiza oosanchchay dees.
Sheshaaney ba macca nayo Yarahas machcho gidana mala immides; izakka izas Attaye geetettiza attuma naa yeladus.
Attayey Naataane yelides; Naataaney Zabaade yelides;
Zabaadey Efilaale yelides; Efilaaley Iyoobeede yelides;
Iyoobeedey Iyu yelides; Iyuy Azaariyaasa yelides;
Azaariyaasi Heleexe yelides; Heleexey El7aasa yelides;
El7aasay Sismaye yelides; Sismayey Shaloome yelides;
Shaloomey Yiqaamiyanne Elshama yelides.
Hankko Attida Kaalebe Yeleta Zarkketa
Yerahim7eele isha Kaalebey bayra naaza Mesha yelides; Meshay Ziife yelides; Ziifey Mareesha yelides; Mareeshayka Kebroone yelides.
Kebrooneykka Qoore, Taaphphuhe, Ereqeemenne Shema7e geetettiza attuma nayta yelides.
Shema7eykka Erahaame yelides; Erahaamey Ereqeeme yelides; Ereqeemey Shamaye yelides.
Shamayey Ma7oone yelides; Ma7ooneykka Beeti-Xuure yelides.
Kaalebes Eefo geetettiza laggeththo machcha dawus; Kaalebey izippe Kaaraane, Moozanne Gazaze geetettiza hara 3 attuma nayta yelides; Haaraaneykka Gazaze geetettiza hara attuma naa yelides.
Yaahiday Ergeme, Iyo7aatame, Geshaane, Paleexe, Eefanne Sha7aafe geetettiza attuma nayta yelides.
Kaalebes Ma7ika geetettiza laggeththo machcha dawus; izakka Sheberenne Tirihaana geetettiza attuma nayta yeladus.
Qasseka Ma7ika Sha7aafenne Shawa yeladus; Sha7aafey Madimaana yelides; Shaway Makibaanenne Gibi7a yelides. Kaalebes Akisa geetettiza macca nay dawus.
Kaalebey yelida hara nayti hayssafe kaalli dizayta; Kaalebey Efraatippe bayra naaza Uure yelides; Uurey Qiriyaate-Yi7aarime aawa Shobaale.
Beeteliheeme aawaa Salamonne Beeti-Gadera aawaa Hareefe yelides.
Qiriyaate-Yi7aarime aawa Shobaale zereththati, Heroheetenne Manahaate qommotappe baggata.
Qasseka Qiriyaate-Yi7aarime zarkketi Yatireta, Puuteta, Shumaateta, Mishiirata, Xora7aatanne Eshtta7ooleta.
Salma Zereththata
Salamo nayti Beeteliheeme, Naxoofeta, Axiroota, Beet Iyo7aabe, Manahaatetappe baggatanne Haxooreta.
Yaabexe katamaan diza xaafizayta zareti qasse Tir7ata, Shim7aatanne Sukoote; hayti Erekaabeta aawaa Hamaateppe yelettida Qenaaweta.
